claims.text: Soft delete delays permanent deletion of backup data and vaults, allowing recovery [1]
Deleted VM backup retained so it can be recovered with no data loss, whether deleted accidentally or maliciously [4][5]
Retained 14 days by default, extendable to 180 days [1][2]
First 14 days free; charged beyond 14 days [1][2]
Retention active at time of deletion governs; then permanently deleted [2]

A.notes: Accurate and supported; omits undelete-before-restore and the no-early-deletion / vault-deletion constraints.

claims.text: Soft delete retains deleted backup data for a configurable period to enable recovery [11]
Retention configuration determines how long soft-deleted items are retained before permanent deletion [10]
VM backups: deleted data retained in soft-delete for 14 days [2]
Azure Files: deleted shares and snapshots retained at least 14 days [3][4]
Soft delete retains items for configured 14-180 days [1]
Recovery points of soft-deleted items not cleaned on expiry [9]
Soft-deleted items show red soft-delete icon during 14 days [8]
A vault containing soft-deleted items cannot be deleted [7]
Enhanced soft delete allows custom retention and always-on [14]

B.notes: [2] and [10] do not state what they are attached to ([3] also lacks the 14-day statement); no cost or undelete facts.

claims.text: PMKs are the default encryption method for Azure VMs [4]
Azure Backup requires CMKs to encrypt backup data in a Backup vault [1]
Recovery Services vault supports CMK encryption of backup data [13]
CMKs must be stored in Azure Key Vault [8]
CMK can be used with system-assigned managed identity [2]
Azure Backup integrates with UserAssignedIdentities for CMK encryption [6]
Registering Microsoft.DataProtection provider required to configure encryption settings [10]
Azure Backup provides Encryption Settings [9]
Azure Backup does not decrypt backup data at any point [7]
MARS agent passphrase encrypts before upload, decrypts after download [5]
Passphrase at least 16 characters [14]
Integrates with Microsoft Entra ID for encrypted VMs using BEK and KEK [11]
Backs up encrypted Azure VMs [12]

claims.text: By default data encrypted with platform-managed keys; 256-bit AES FIPS 140-2 at rest [1][2][3][6]

MARS passphrase (>=16 chars) encrypts before upload; Microsoft never decrypts, keeps no key copy [3][4][9]
Data in transit over HTTPS/TLS 1.2+, remains on Azure backbone [1][2][3][6]
